lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜游走于暗绿的沼泽间

lines.en: Its long snout splits the surface.
It swings its tail to turn.
It glides past the edge of the water weeds.
A row of sharp teeth flashes by.
It sinks slowly into deeper mud.
One flick of the tail and it slips into the weeds.
It loops around a sunken log.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息在淤泥底部
lines.en: Rest quietly at the muck bottom

lines.zh: 静静躺在柔软的淤泥中
lines.en: Lie still in the soft muck
Come to a gentle stop at the bottom

lines.zh: 静静躺在柔软的河床上
lines.en: Lie still on the soft riverbed

lines.zh: 我半沉在淤泥上，等一口空气。
lines.en: I hang half-sunk in the silt, waiting for a breath of air.
It holds its mouth open, perfectly still.
Only its gill covers move, slowly.

lines.zh: 它悬在浑水里像截木头
lines.en: It hangs in the murk like a log.
It releases a slow string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 沼泽的深水里，我一动不动。
lines.en: In the swamp's deep water I hold still.

lines.zh: 沼泽深处，我的长吻先探出来。
lines.en: In deep swamp, my long snout comes out first.

lines.zh: 我的长吻对着你的倒影。
lines.en: My long snout points at your reflection.

lines.zh: 凝视你的身影，准备行动
lines.en: Gaze at you, ready to act
Watch you, waiting for an opening

lines.zh: 我的鳍被划开一道口子。
lines.en: A gash opens along my fin.

lines.zh: 不知道什么时候被伤到的……

lines.en: I smell the dried fish you carry.

lines.zh: 享受我的汁液，它很鲜美！
lines.en: Enjoy my juice, it's very delicious!
Don't give up, my meat is tastier!
My meat is tender and juicy!
Taste my blood, it's very delicious!
My long snout nudges your shin.

lines.zh: 我身体坚硬，你撞不动我！
lines.en: My body is hard, you can't撞 me!

lines.zh: 我的身体让你无法穿透！

lines.en: My body is too hard to撞动！

lines.zh: 你的靴子蹭到了它的背鳍
lines.en: Your boot scrapes its dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 沼泽深水底下，我这张长嘴最管用。
lines.en: In deep swamp water this long snout works best.

lines.zh: 沼泽深水里，只有我一条。
lines.en: In this deep swamp water, I am alone.

lines.zh: 我贴近水草，等同类游过。
lines.en: I hug the weeds and wait for my own kind.

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，繁殖后代！

lines.en: I need to reproduce, find a mate!
I want to mate, find me!

lines.zh: 沼泽的水太浑，看不清伴。
lines.en: The swamp water is too murky to find a mate.
The swamp is deep here, do not come close.

lines.zh: 沼泽深水里，我的长嘴先到。
lines.en: In deep swamp water my long snout arrives first.

lines.zh: 沼泽的深水，谁也找不到我。
lines.en: In the deep swamp water, no one finds me.

lines.zh: 这口鳄鱼牙，咬住就不放。
lines.en: These gator jaws will not let go.

lines.zh: 我在水底跟着你的影子。
lines.en: I follow your shadow along the bottom.

lines.zh: 沼泽深水底下，我张着嘴等。
lines.en: At the swamp bottom, mouth open, I wait.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，你感到毛骨悚然。
lines.en: A low growl sends shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 试图靠近我，你会后悔的。
lines.en: Try to get close and you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 我的嘴大得吓人，小心点。
lines.en: My mouth is big. Watch out.
You don't want to mess with me.

lines.zh: 我在这里已经很久了，别打扰我。
lines.en: I've been here for a while. Leave me alone.

lines.zh: 沼泽深水，是我晒太阳的地方。
lines.en: The deep swamp is where I bask.
My big mouth is for hunting.
You humans stay away from me.

lines.zh: 我的叫声可以吓跑入侵者。

lines.en: The deep water is my territory.
Deep in the marsh, I sway my tail slowly.

lines.zh: 育苗槽的水把我孵了出来。
lines.en: The hatchery water hatched me out.

lines.zh: 我在寻找合适的栖息地。
lines.en: I'm looking for a good habitat.
Wait for the right time to spawn.

lines.zh: 深水下的泥里钻出一条
lines.en: One rises out of the deep-water mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽水面破开，它浮上来
lines.en: The swamp surface breaks and it floats up.

lines.zh: 我被扎破了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I got a刺伤 — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片裂开了，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My scales are裂开 — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 身体出了点问题，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Something's wrong — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 这条伤口好痛，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: This wound hurts — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我开始感到虚弱，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I'm feeling weak — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 不知道是不是伤到了，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I think I'm hurt — and the void makes it worse.
